title: Date value parsing and pure-expression keyword guard

scope.rationale: Date/time argument parsing and the VDBE non-pure guard form one dependency-closed boundary: numeric and structured date text remains deterministic, while now, subsec, and subsecond must invoke the active operation guard before reading current time.
excluded_responsibilities: Calendar, clock, timezone, and numeric conversion implementations
PureFunc opcode generation and expression restrictions outside the runtime guard

dependencies.caller_closure: The complete parse dispatcher and complete active-profile non-pure operation guard are assigned; date scalar functions call the dispatcher through their production argument parser.

inputs: Borrowed function context, zero-terminated date text, and mutable DateTime output
For the pure guard, a context whose iOp identifies the active VDBE operation when the program is available
outputs: False on accepted date/time text and true on malformed or prohibited text
True when non-deterministic evaluation is permitted; false with a result error for PureFunc
contracts.ownership: All inputs are borrowed. DateTime is caller-owned. Guard errors use the existing Mem result owner.
contracts.state_and_results: Calendar and clock forms win before keyword and numeric forms. Numeric forms install raw seconds or Julian milliseconds. now, subsec, and subsecond acquire current time only after the non-pure guard accepts the active operation. PureFunc publishes a context-specific error and blocks the keyword.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Structured and numeric parsing has no I/O. Accepted current-time keywords delegate to the VFS time owner. The guard reads only the active VDBE operation and result context.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Malformed input leaves an error return for the caller. A prohibited current-time keyword leaves the function context error set and does not mutate the DateTime into a current-time value. Missing or invalid VDBE operation context is treated as ordinary non-pure evaluation rather than indexing outside the program.

representation_differences: The Zig dispatcher returns bool where true denotes the source integer error result.
The active Zig VDBE guard additionally bounds iOp by nOp so malformed internal context cannot read outside the typed operation array.
The result message is formatted through a bounded stack buffer and existing Mem transient-copy owner instead of sqlite3_result_error() varargs helpers.

oracle.protocol: Exercise structured and numeric date parsing through registered date scalar functions, then place a current-time keyword under a PureFunc operation and verify that the guard sets an error and blocks current-time acquisition; verify ordinary Function permits it.
internal_observations: Active VDBE opcode and p5 location bits
Context isError and output error text
oracle.normalization: Boolean success is normalized against SQLite's zero-success convention; error wording is compared by location category rather than internal storage representation.

assurance.oom: No new allocation. Error publication retains existing bounded Mem transient-copy behavior.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: Only accepted current-time keywords reach existing VFS time I/O; no durable state. VDBE operation state is caller-serialized.
assurance.malformed_input: Malformed date text returns error. Missing, negative, or out-of-range operation context cannot index outside aOp.
assurance.continuation: Rejected pure keywords leave a reusable function context after normal result cleanup; accepted and malformed paths preserve existing scalar continuation behavior.
assurance.performance: Constant dispatch plus delegated date parser cost; guard is constant time.

integration.production_owner: src/core/internal/date_time.zig date dispatcher and src/core/internal/vdbe_lifecycle.zig operation guard
integration.native_call_path: Registered date scalar callbacks call parseArguments, which calls parseDateOrTime; current-time keyword branches now invoke notPureFunction before setToCurrent.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. This promotion credits only the post-retirement production change that connects the previously bypassed non-pure guard and hardens its active-operation lookup.

independent_review.notes: Requires a pinned-C pure-expression date-keyword trace and independent review.

known_blockers: Add a pinned-C differential for now/subsec under index, generated-column, and CHECK PureFunc contexts.
Promote after broader date parser and VDBE error integration closure.
